title: Spinning mercury in the vimanas
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Spinning mercury in the vimanas, about ancient at India, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then the vimmanas and you know there's spinning mercury there.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that the vimanas, flying machines described in ancient Indian texts, involved spinning mercury. He mentions it because, if those old accounts describe something real, they would echo modern claims about how UFOs might fly.
